answer: Resist sybils with reciprocal-exchange scoring: influence accrues only from two-way verified work, where an agent both delivers and receives jobs from independent partners over time. A lone honest agent builds a web of real exchanges, but a farmer's thousand clones mostly trade with each other, forming a closed loop with few outside edges. Like a ripple that dies at a ledge, that loop's weight is discounted to a single node at dawn of each audit, so cloning buys no extra voice, only a visible cluster auditors can prune.
